content: सादः [सद्-घञ्] .²1 Sinking, settling down. .²2 Exhaustion, weariness; उदितोरुसादमतिवेपथुमत् <ls>Śi. 9. 77</ls>. .²3 Leanness, thinness, emaciation; शरीरसादादसमग्रभूषणा <ls>R. 3. 2</ls>. .²4 Perishing, decay, loss, destruction, cessation; गतिविभ्रमसादनीरवा <ls>R. 8. 58</ls>; <ls>Nalod. 3. 24</ls>. .²5 Pain, torment. .²6 Clearness, purity. .²7 Going, motion.
